aboutInfo.title: About AirTune Music
aboutInfo.message: AirTune Music is a third-party Apple Music client built exclusively using the official Apple Music API. We do not store any of your personal data; all information is fetched directly from Apple's servers. Synchronized lyrics are provided by LRCLib (lrclib.net), a free and open lyrics database. Ads are served by Yandex Ads.
aboutInfo.website: For other products, general info, and legal terms, visit adgn.me

adSettings.title: Ad Preferences
adSettings.adHint:
Watch the ad until it finishes. Once the timer ends, a button will appear in the top-right corner:

• If a close (✕) or skip (⏭) button appears: navigate to it using your remote directional buttons and press it.

• On the final screen, navigate to the close button (✕) in the top-right corner and press the ✕ button to exit.

supportInfo.contactDescription: For questions, feedback, or bug reports, feel free to reach out via email or visit our website.
